Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI YP-II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI YP-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICAR IARI YP-II Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 23 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the YP-II post at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding/Plant Physiology/ Seed Science & Technology/ Biotechnology and allied disciplines of Life Sciences to be eligible for the YP-II post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the YP-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the YP-II position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the YP-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ICAR IARI YP-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs. A duly filled application form might also be required.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the YP-II post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ICAR IARI, Samastipur, Bihar, PIN 848125.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the YP-II post is a contractual position. The job type is mentioned as Contractual in the official notification.
